description: A warm, intimate bedroom corner featuring a paneled headboard wall that combines rich dark walnut wood grain panels above with a wide linen-textured upholstered panel insert below — the contrast of materials creates a layered, hotel-quality backdrop. The bed has a saddle tan cognac leather upholstered headboard with a low, rectangular silhouette. Bedding is layered in warm cream and ivory tones — a crinkled cotton duvet or sheet, a warm ivory pillow, and a chunky knit throw at the foot suggesting lived-in comfort. To the left of the bed sits a small walnut-stained nightstand with a single drawer, topped with a clear glass bud vase holding a few delicate dried branches with tiny white blooms. A white rocker switch plate is mounted on the upholstered panel above the nightstand. A concentrated warm amber spotlight pools down from the wall onto the nightstand surface and upper pillow area, casting soft shadow on the linen-textured panel and creating a cozy reading atmosphere. The overall color palette is warm earth tones — cognac, walnut brown, ivory, and oat — with the glass vase providing a subtle transparent accent. Camera is at seated to standing eye-level, normal lens, three-quarter view of the bed headboard corner emphasizing the left nightstand side.
